capabilities: Send the current note to a MarkPage instance in the browser
Resolve wiki-link and Markdown image references when syncing
Apply one of ten built-in themes before sending
Extract the H1 heading as the cover title
Run a local HTTP server to serve note content and images
disambiguation: Not a vault or device syncing tool; it sends individual notes to the MarkPage web editor for visual rendering.
extras: README is written in Chinese. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian desktop v0.15.0+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand a note and its embedded images to an external Markdown-to-image editor for making social media visuals.

relations.evidence: 一键将笔记（含图片）同步到 MarkPage —— 一个 Markdown 转精美图片的编辑器

summary: One-click sender that pushes the current note, including images, to the MarkPage web editor that turns Markdown into styled social-media images.
